svg.title: PlanContext: fields, groups and related types
svg.desc: One object per Plan() call. Eight public fields in four groups, five helper methods, and the types its fields hold.

g.text: PlanContext: fields, groups and related types

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Everything a single Plan() call knows and builds lives in this one object. Plan() creates it, every later stage receives the same shared_ptr, and it is freed when Plan() returns.
